notes: Source is the Bahrain/Qatar eAIP AD 2 OBBI page effective 4 Sep 2025, the newest that could be opened. The Bahrain AIM site shows AIRAC 02/26 (9 Jul 2026) as current, but that page could not be opened; re-check before publishing. WebFetch returned only AD 2.1 to AD 2.12 of the page, so AD 2.20 to 2.22 (local rules, noise, night, slots) could not be read. AD 2.3 'AD operator' hours read 'SUN - THU 04:00 - 11:15' (office hours, time basis not shown) and were not recorded as airport hours. Facts from the superseded edition other than runway, location and operator were not used (customs, handling, fuel, max_aircraft, notable).
